readme.excerpt: An open source library of creative, framework-agnostic components drawn on canvas. Fluid simulations, shader effects, and 3D scenes, running over your live, fully interactive interface or drawn entirely on their own. WebGL or WebGPU via vgpu, your choice. canvasui.dev · Docs · Components · Playground · Installation · Rendering What makes it different Effects come in two categories: - Live HTML effects use the HTML-in-canvas API, on by default in Chrome 157, to draw your real DOM into the canvas. Text stays selectable, links stay clickable, and the page becomes a texture that fire, fluid, and glass distort in real time. Where the API is missing, they fall back to a GPU overlay or plain HTML, so every visitor gets a working page. - Universal effects draw their whole scene on the GPU instead of capturing the page, so they look and behave the same in every modern browser. 🎨 38 components and counting: Liquid, Glass, Shatter, Force Field, Chrome Object, and more 🧩 Framework agnostic : every component ships for React, Solid, Preact, Vue, Svelte, and vanilla, in both WebGL and WebGPU builds 🖥️ Two renderers : WebGL with GLSL, or WebGPU through vgpu with WGSL 📋 Copy, do not install : source lands in your repo via a shadcn-compatible registry ⚡ Zero config : self-contained, with sensible defaults and typed props 🤖 MCP ready : let your AI assistant find and install components for yo
